newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan watchdog declines comment on Vitec report.
newsitem.headline: Japan watchdog declines comment on Vitec report.

text.p: Japan's securities watchdog declined to comment on Wednesday on a report that it had begun investigating whether a senior executive of semiconductor trading firm Vitec Co Ltd had carried out insider trading.
A Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission official said the body could not comment on the report, carried by Japan's NHK public television.

The television report said the investigation concerned the buying of shares in Shintom Co Ltd shortly before the company made a third-party allocation of shares in August 1994 with the aim of raising its capital.
Shintom is an audio-visual equipment maker.
Officials at Vitec were not immediately available for comment.
Shintom said it could not immediately make any comment on the reported investigation.
